# ethereum-optimism/optimism Daily Update (May 29, 2026)
## OVERVIEW 
Today's development focused on enhancing Supernode RPC stability, refining contract upgrade mechanisms, and integrating super permissioned dispute game support. Significant progress was made in fixing acceptance test flakiness and updating the Superchain registry.

## KEY TECHNICAL DEVELOPMENTS

### Supernode Stability and Interoperability Enhancements
Improvements were made to the Supernode's RPC router to prevent dispatching requests to virtual nodes during lifecycle transitions, ensuring greater stability and fixing interop reorg recovery ([#21103](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21103)). Additionally, the `op-deployer` and `op-contracts` were integrated into the `just release` command for streamlined deployment processes ([#21102](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21102)).

### Contract Security and Upgrade Mechanism Refinements
A critical bug fix was implemented to prevent upgrades to OpenZeppelin v5 style Initializable contracts if their ERC-7201 storage slot is already in use, enhancing contract security ([#21070](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21070)). Documentation for the L2 contracts release process was also updated to reflect changes from the L2ContractsManager process ([#21073](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21073)).

### Dispute Game and Acceptance Test Stabilization
The implementation of a super permissioned dispute game was added, including contract wiring, deployment, and integration across various components like the proposer, dispute monitor, and challenger ([#20641](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20641)). Concurrently, the `op-challenger` was updated to stop handling super permissioned games as they do not require challenger interaction ([#21099](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21099)). Flaky acceptance tests, specifically `TestReorgUnsafeHead` and `TestFollowL2_WithoutCLP2P`, were stabilized to improve CI reliability ([#21112](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21112), [#21104](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21104)).

### Superchain Registry Updates and Wording Refinements
The Superchain registry was updated across various components, including `op-core`, `rust/op-reth`, and `packages/contracts-bedrock` ([#21095](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21095)). Terminology related to "supervisor" was renamed to "interop" in `op-interop-filter` and `op-reth` to align with current interop API wording ([#20866](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/20866)).

## NEWLY OPENED PULL REQUESTS
- [#21118](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21118) review(rust): add rust-review just recipe for AI-assisted review
- [#21116](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21116) fix(interop): drain cross-safe verification backlog with adaptive backoff
- [#21115](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21115) feat(op-interop-filter): correct + per-reason failsafe metrics & logs
- [#21111](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21111) fix(op-node): preserve safedb across EL-sync restarts
- [#21109](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21109) docs: add op-interop-filter chain-operator tool page
- [#21108](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21108) feat(op-reth): seed slot-preimage DB during state-dump import
- [#21107](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21107) feat(op-supernode,op-sync-tester): drive supernode VN via sync-tester EL + finalize anchor at genesis
- [#21106](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21106) op-dispute-mon: support simplified super permissioned games
- [#21105](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21105) Lagoon hardfork rename

## CLOSED ISSUES

### Contract Release Process and Upgrade Management
The issue regarding updating the contracts release process to include L2 contracts has been closed ([#18839](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/18839)). Additionally, the task to disable upgrades to V5 initializers in the L2CM has been resolved ([#20808](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20808)).

### Karst-Specific Code Removal
The task to remove Karst-specific upgrade transactions from `GenerateNUTBundle` has been completed, simplifying the bundle generation process now that Karst has been deployed across chains ([#19369](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/19369)).

### Super Permissioned Dispute Game Integration
The feature to add a simplified super permissioned dispute game has been closed ([#20834](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20834)). Concurrently, the `op-challenger` has been updated to remove its interaction with these simplified games, as they do not require challenger intervention ([#20932](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20932)).

### Supernode RPC Stability
The issue concerning gating per-chain RPC during virtual node pause-and-restart in `op-supernode` has been addressed, improving RPC stability during interop reorgs ([#20854](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20854)).

## NEW ISSUES

### Interop Verification Backlog and Ecosystem Integration
A new issue highlights a problem where the `op-supervisor`/`op-supernode` cross-safe cannot drain a backlog faster than real-time after a stall, impacting interop verification ([#21117](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21117)). There's also a need to review ecosystem integration for the new transaction type (0x7d) to ensure block explorers visualize and process it correctly ([#21110](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21110)).

### Withdrawal Prove Script and Interop NUT Bundle Follow-ups
The withdrawal prove script in `op-chain-ops` does not currently support super roots, posing a challenge for devnet operations ([#21113](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21113)). Additionally, follow-up tasks from the Interop NUT bundle activation are being tracked to address review feedback and further refine the implementation ([#21114](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/21114)).

## ACTIVE ISSUES

### Flaky Test: `TestReorgUnsafeHead` ([#20198](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20198))
The `TestReorgUnsafeHead` test continues to be flaky in CI. The root cause was identified as the test picking the next block's parent by reading the EL's mutable `eth.Unsafe` label, which could lag behind `op-reth`'s canonical-tag swap, leading to the EL reorging back to the original chain. A fix has been opened in [#21112](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/pull/21112) which replaces fixed sleeps with a poll on `SyncStatus().UnsafeL2.Hash` and uses `ReorgExact` for assertions, tolerating CI overload.

### Interop Proofs Devnet ([#20489](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20489))
Progress is being made on deploying a network with SuperRootMigrations and InteropPortal contract feature flags. A SuperFaultDisputeGame has been played and resolved. The main remaining task is to verify withdrawals, but the first withdrawal initiated on the devnet requires a 7-day waiting period for finalization. The `op-chain-ops` script for proving withdrawals is currently not working and needs to be fixed.

### [L2CM] Add setWithdrawalRoute to FeeVaults ([#20806](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/optimism/issues/20806))
This issue is currently blocked due to a problem with the `TestActivationBlockNUTBundle` in Go. The test, which starts from the `L2Genesis.s.sol` generated state, fails when an L2 contract's semver is bumped because the L2CM code prevents upgrading to a lower semver. This prevents the bundle from being executed against the locally generated genesis state, making modifications to L2 contracts painful until a solution is found for the test's deficiency.
